title: Finger Care
texts: A simple routine to look after your digits

3 simple exercises to help maintain finger and hand health

Pen rolling can be done with any size pen and throughout the day. In this session we have set a timer for 30 seconds to be completed twice on both hands
Finger stretches are a great way to stretch the individual fingers compared to wrist stretches. Stretch each finger for 10 seconds (including the thumb) before moving on. There are two sets total
Finger glides are awesome for finger health. Make sure each rep is slow and controlled. Complete 30 seconds of glides for 2 sets on both hands with a short 20 second rest period to shake out.
